summary.text: Thomas Keane described AI as a major part of technology transforming clinical care and said it currently handles note-taking and low-volume administrative tasks for doctors. In March 2026 Senate testimony, he said the Administration believes in AI’s power to improve health care and is leading with a “try-first” culture, while describing HHS/ONC efforts such as an AI-focused RFI and the HTI-5 proposed rule aimed at AI-enabled interoperability. In June 2026 remarks, he said HHS’s goal is to improve access, affordability, and healthcare impact through technology including AI, and he described AI uses in clinical trials, drug discovery, public health surveillance, and patient empowerment.
